QuestInfo.name: Establish Friendly Relations
QuestInfo.0: Receive the official letter regarding friendly relations between the Nova and Cygnus Knights from #bNeinheart#k in #bEreve#k.
QuestInfo.1: Deliver the official letter regarding friendly relations between the Nova and Cygnus Knights from Neinheart to #bBeldar#k in #bPantheon#k.
QuestInfo.2: Beldar received the official letter and was pleased with the contents. Perhaps an alliance will form from this first step.

0.0: This is the #bofficial letter of the Cygnus Knights#k. We would like you to be our liason between the Cygnus Knights and Nova, and deliver this to the #bNova Council#k.

yes.0: We hope this relationship will eventually grow into an alliance.
